value_question: Can two-frame state and a simple population-local operation preserve the small semantic residual and contextual cell identities required by H-54/H-55/H-75?
assumptions: 60 cells per polarity; illustrative linear aggregate readout in common units; no phase-selection law chosen.
Arithmetic comparison is independent of any chosen cancellation amount.
Float storage is nearest ties-to-even; population arithmetic in binary64 isolates information lost at state write-back.
No product implementation, new state field, controller, test suite or actual trained SNN.

context_preserving_candidate.condition: If an equal amount c is removed from each population, and relative current strengths within each affected population should be preserved
context_preserving_candidate.rule: P=sum(p_i), M=sum(m_i); 0<=c<=min(P,M); p_i_next=p_i*(P-c)/P for P>0; m_i_next=m_i*(M-c)/M for M>0; zero population stays zero.
context_preserving_candidate.deduction: Uniform positive rescaling is forced by preserving all within-population strength ratios together with the specified total. It adds no per-cell identity mapping or persistent field.
limits: The full c=min(P,M) active-rate operation is selected by H-77; its units, predictive-state treatment and transition timing still require specification.
Near P=M, the surviving amplitude may be dominated by numerical error or stochastic input; no semantic valence follows from coordinate sign.
Full c=min(P,M) removes the weaker polarity and all its current contextual activity; predictive alternatives need explicit phase semantics.
Uniform scaling preserves ratios but not necessarily the active-cell count defined by a threshold.
A local working vector may be used by an eventual implementation; this analysis allocates no persistent scratch array.
context_preserving_candidate.human_scope_update: H-77 selects c=min(P,M) and proportional surviving active rates. The general-c derivation remains explanatory; it is no longer a competing amount choice for the specified active-rate operation.

pairwise_index_counterexample.interpretation: All give signed total .5, but arbitrary index pairing changes surviving cell identities and unsigned activity when the negative array is reordered. No opposite-polarity path correspondence was specified. This is a reason to avoid inventing such correspondence, not proof that proportional cancellation is selected.

human_direction.rule: Full minicolumn net cancellation and proportional retention of active rates in the surviving direction; no index pairing.
human_direction.scope: Active spiking-rate operation; prediction handling, transfer timing and exact state representation remain open.
